title: Computing Power for Reasoning in the Agent Era: Where Are GPU, HBM, and Compute Chips Heading?
excerpt: Agents are driving the competition in AI chips from individual chips to entire systems. This article breaks down the profit sources of cloud platforms, data centers, GPUs, HBM, and advanced packaging by examining a specific task, while also looking at how contracts and financing can accelerate development, with on-device AI serving as a second demand curve to be verified.
body: The way agents work is shifting the competition in AI chips from individual chips to entire systems. Agents plan steps, invoke tools, read results, and then proceed with further reasoning. With each step taken, the model may need to reprocess the context, read from and write to the KV Cache, thereby consuming computational, memory, and network resources. Therefore, compared to token usage, what is more important to track currently is: ==blue|**Effective Token Ratio**====blue| versus ====blue|**Cost per inference call required for unit payment value**====blue|. == Agents will continue to drive up demand for cloud-based inference, and this demand will also spread upstream to areas such as GPUs, HBM, advanced packaging, servers, networks, power supply, and liquid cooling. Profits will not be distributed evenly across all aspects of capacity expansion. The areas that are more likely to enjoy premium pricing are those that either have control over scarce production capacity, high yields, and customer certifications, or are able to integrate chips, software scheduling, and customer billing into a stable delivery system. ==blue|At the same time, long-term contracts, upfront payments, and debt financing turn future usage expectations into current investments in data centers and equipment. Once actual demand falls below the assumptions made during procurement, pressure will first show up in price indicators such as rental costs, with utilization rates and asset returns following later.== The on-device side forms the second demand curve. Cars and home devices indeed require lower latency, offline capabilities, and local data processing, but this curve still needs to be validated through factors such as usage frequency, device cost, and product gross margin. The cloud computing sector is already in an era of large-scale development, while the on-device approach is currently more of a hypothesis waiting to be proven by actual product performance. ## Agent turns task completion into a new cost unit In ordinary Q&A sessions, there is usually only one round of input and output. The Agent breaks a goal down into multiple steps, invokes external tools, retrieves the results, and then decides on the next step. A single task may involve multiple rounds of model invocation, with different steps requiring models of varying sizes. The total cost is determined by the number of invocations, the length of the context, the cache hit rate, and retry attempts in case of failures. Large model inference typically involves Prefill and Decode. Prefill processes the already provided input, allowing for relatively efficient parallel computation. Decode generates new tokens one by one, requiring repeated access to the model weights and the previously generated KV Cache, making it more susceptible to memory bandwidth constraints. As the context length increases, the amount of space occupied by the KV Cache also grows with the batch size and sequence length. At this point, the computing peak remains important, while memory capacity, bandwidth, inter-card communication, and scheduling efficiency also directly limit throughput. I will use the following account to compare different reasoning systems. ```text Cost per million valid tokens = Total system cost per hour ÷ Valid tokens generated per hour × 1,000,000 ``` The total system cost includes accelerators, HBM, servers, networking, power, liquid cooling, software, hosting, and depreciation. The hourly effective Token output needs to be calculated under fixed models, average input and output lengths, concurrency levels, latency, and quality requirements. Results due to queue timeouts, failed retries, or those that do not meet quality standards should not be counted as output. Input Tokens, output Tokens, and cache hits also need to be recorded separately. Once the cost per unit of work decreases, more tasks and ideas that can generate potential revenue can be incorporated into various products and processes. As prices continue to fall, usage levels may also increase. This growth is contingent on two conditions: the task completion rate and the value of the results must both meet specified standards. Simply generating more tokens will only increase device usage without automatically creating healthy demand. ## How an Agent task translates into infrastructure profits A billable task first generates requirements for model invocation and context processing, before giving rise to purchases for computing power, memory, interconnects, and data centers. The diagram below presents these requirement flows, the on-device second curve, and financial risks as three layers. Moving from left to right, the stages closer to the user make it easier to control scheduling and billing, while those further upstream rely more on capacity, yield rates, and certifications to establish bargaining power. **GPUs, ASICs, and software stacks** The profit foundation for GPUs lies in their versatility, mature software ecosystem, and ability to quickly adapt to new models. As model architectures and request formats continue to evolve, customers can use the same hardware and tools to handle training, development, and various inference tasks, with migration costs remaining relatively controllable. ASICs can optimize costs and energy efficiency by leveraging fixed models, fixed precision, and consistent request patterns. Their economic viability depends on three conditions being met: the workload must be large enough so that long-term utilization can cover the costs associated with chip development and deployment; the software must be able to integrate the customer’s existing models, operators, and operational processes. For example, AWS combines the Trainium and Neuron software stacks with servers, networking, and cloud services in one unified product suite, while Google uses TPUs, interconnects, and Pathways to support large-scale inference. This shows that the competitive unit for specialized chips has expanded to include entire systems. It is difficult to determine whether a single chip can generate sustained profits by merely comparing its theoretical performance. **HBM and Advanced Packaging** Long contexts and concurrent requests increase the weight and memory usage of the KV Cache, while decoding requires continuous data transfer. As a result, the capacity and bandwidth of HBM affect the utilization rate of accelerators. Advanced packaging is responsible for combining computing chips with multiple HBM modules, while also meeting requirements regarding yield, power consumption, and customer certifications. When supply is limited in the short term, suppliers who can deliver qualified products consistently are more likely to receive premium prices. ==blue|Such premiums have clear conditions for declining. When new production capacity is added, yield improves, alternative solutions are approved, or customers start diversifying their suppliers, the bargaining power resulting from supply constraints weakens== (for example, with the emergence of many companies like CXMT). As of September 2026, TSMC has raised its full-year capital expenditure guidance to $60 billion to $64 billion, citing customer-driven capacity expansion as the main reason. SK hynix revealed that HBM4 production began in the second quarter of 2026, with output increasing further in the second half of the year, and it has already signed long-term agreements with around ten key customers. While these companies indicate that demand and capacity expansion are occurring simultaneously, this is not sufficient to prove that current premiums can be sustained in the long term. **Servers, Networks, Power, and Liquid Cooling** Only when GPUs and HBM are installed in servers, connected to low-latency networks, and supplied with stable power can they form deployable computing power. Google provides Ironwood with a liquid-cooling setup featuring up to 9,216 chips, and the entire system consumes nearly 10 MW of power. While this product specification does not represent all clusters, it shows that the scope of procurement has expanded beyond just chips. The profits from these aspects typically come from power access, delivery speed, system integration, and reliability. They also entail ==blue|**longer construction periods and higher capital investment**==. Even after the data center is built, depreciation, maintenance, and power contracts continue to exist. Revenue can grow rapidly with new construction orders, while capital returns depend on whether the equipment is deployed on schedule, whether the utilization rate meets expectations, and whether the contracts cover the asset recovery period. **Scheduling Software and Cloud Platforms** Cloud providers control customer access points, model deployment, task routing, and billing. Scheduling software can improve batch processing efficiency, reuse caches, reduce idle time and failed retries, allowing the same hardware to handle more tasks. Cloud platforms can also distribute workloads between GPUs and custom ASICs, turning changes in hardware costs into customer prices or platform gross margins. This portion of the profit depends on the scale of customer usage, software compatibility, and migration costs; it is also influenced by price competition and capital expenditures. Only when task-related revenues and cash flows keep up can the advantages of such systems be transformed into sustainable returns, after cloud service providers have purchased more equipment. ## Financing allows supply construction to precede final revenue AI infrastructure has a long procurement and construction cycle. Cloud providers plan computing power based on customer needs, GPU cloud service providers build data centers according to contracts, and server, memory, and packaging manufacturers expand production based on orders. At each stage, there are relatively early procurement signals, but it is often only after the equipment is available that it can be determined whether end-users will continue to pay for it. TSMC’s management mentioned during the earnings call for the second quarter of 2026 that the demands submitted by each customer may be legitimate, but it is still necessary to make a judgment after adding up all those demands. The company will also monitor the progress of data center construction, location selection, and rack setup to prevent chips from ending up in inventory after delivery. This statement indicates that upstream manufacturers are already aware of the gap between orders and actual deployment. At the same time, NVIDIA is already working with financial institutions to package its chips as financial assets in order to invest in small startups. By doing so, it can expand its sales while indirectly participating in investments in cutting-edge technologies and establishing strong ties with these companies. Under the terms of the agreements, these startups are required to continue purchasing chips from NVIDIA on a periodic basis. Alternatively, Meta sets up shell companies to undertake data center construction; although this does not affect the parent company’s financial results on paper, such financial engineering practices could have destructive consequences due to subsequent industry instability or other factors. These two things point to the same mechanism. Financing shifts the decision-making point forward and also moves the risks away from the decision-makers. When cloud providers and GPU cloud service providers purchase equipment, the assets and depreciation are recorded in their own accounts, while the debts and leasing obligations remain fixed. Once the equipment is put into use, depreciation, electricity costs, and interest continue to accrue, regardless of whether there are tasks running on it; the only things they can lock in ahead of time are contracts and upfront payments, while the only thing that can be postponed is whether the end-users are willing to keep paying. Purchase orders are then issued layer by layer along the same chain. Cloud service providers allocate computing power according to the contracts, while GPU cloud service providers build data centers based on those same contracts; server, memory, and packaging manufacturers then expand their production in response to these orders. Each level relies on the confirmed signals from the level above, with no single level able to see the total actual usage across all levels. Contracts convert expected usage over the next few years into orders today, and the combined supply resulting from these orders may exceed current payment demands. While each individual decision at a particular level is reasonable, the sum of these decisions can still exceed the actual usage level. None of these phenomena prove that a bubble has formed, but they constantly indicate that the level of leverage is increasing. They show that long-term contracts and financing can convert future revenues into servers, GPUs, and data centers today. As valid workloads continue to grow, building in advance can shorten delivery times and improve asset utilization. Even if demand growth, renewal rates, or utilization fall short of the assumptions made during procurement, costs such as leasing, depreciation, electricity, and interest will still continue to arise. ==blue|Pressure does not appear across all indicators at the same time, nor is it distributed evenly. Even as the total number of model invocations continues to rise, if supply grows faster, price-related signals are the first to be affected, including GPU rental prices, residual values of used devices, server inventory, and certain memory prices. Utilization rates and renewal rates are outcomes of operational performance and lag behind; asset returns become apparent only after a full cycle of depreciation and interest has passed. Suppliers may continue to receive orders before demand at the end of the chain slows down, until a certain point where it becomes clear that the additional revenue is not sufficient to cover capital costs. Only then does the financial amplification effect work in reverse, resulting in a bullwhip effect.== ## On-device is the second curve that awaits verification through usage behavior. Car assistants and home control hubs need to respond quickly, even in poor network conditions, and must still complete certain tasks. Since vehicle status, home sensors, and personal habits involve privacy issues, local processing can reduce the amount of data that needs to be uploaded. On-device processing is well-suited for tasks such as wake-up, sensing, simple decision-making, and frequent control, while complex reasoning and long-context handling can still be handled by the cloud. ^[It is also more suitable for future functions such as memory and continuous learning in on-device intelligent assistants.] Local execution consumes power from the user’s device, and device manufacturers still have to bear the initial investment costs. Higher-specification SoCs, memory, and storage increase the Bill of Materials cost, while cooling, model adaptation, security, OTA updates, and long-term after-sales support also require engineering resources. Manufacturers will only have reason to bear these costs in the long term if local inference enables higher pricing, reduces cloud-based processing expenses, improves the user experience, or meets privacy and offline requirements. On-device chips also need to process model updates while operating with limited power consumption. Low-bit computing, more efficient memory architectures, and on-cloud scheduling can help alleviate these constraints, but just being able to deploy something does not necessarily mean there is a stable demand for it. The actual usage frequency of cars and home devices, the proportion of operations performed locally, the incremental hardware costs, and the gross profit of products remain the most important metrics for validating this curve. Once on-device applications become part of high-frequency devices, the requirements will be more diverse and closer to users' actual daily behaviors. The available materials so far are not sufficient to prove that this stage has arrived, so I will keep it as the second curve, without assuming large-scale chip orders in the product demonstrations yet. ## Signals for Ongoing Monitoring in the Future For cloud services, the demand is determined by the volume of paid tasks, task completion rates, and revenue per task. Valid tokens can assist in comparing reasoning systems, but they need to be considered alongside latency, quality, and failure rates. Cloud service providers’ capital expenditures should translate into revenue from AI cloud services, improved cash flow, and higher output per megawatt. In terms of the supply chain, it is necessary to observe whether there is a divergence in prices and inventory levels between HBM and standard DRAM, whether the delivery times for advanced packaging are shortening, and whether GPU rental prices and second-hand residual values are starting to decline. The profits resulting from supply constraints can only be transformed into sustainable advantages if good yield rates, certification advantages, and customer loyalty can be maintained even after capacity expansion. In terms of the financial structure, it is necessary to consider whether the contract duration, debt maturity period, and the economic lifespan of GPUs are compatible with each other. Customer renewals, the progress of deploying servers in data centers, and their utilization rates can help determine whether long-term contracts reflect actual demand or represent the anticipation of future demand being accounted for in today’s investments. On-device metrics to watch include the average daily usage frequency of the assistant, the proportion of tasks completed locally, and the gross profit per device. Only when cars and home devices start handling frequent tasks will the demand for on-device chips shift from a competition over specifications to product capabilities that users are willing to use consistently. If effective tasks and revenue can keep up with the supply of computing power, there is still room for growth in GPUs, ASICs, HBM, packaging, and data centers. Profits will remain concentrated in those areas that can reduce the cost per task, gain control over limited supplies, or manage customers and scheduling processes. When leading indicators such as rental prices and residual values continue to decline, and utilization rates, renewal rates, and asset returns remain below the assumptions made at the time of acquisition, even if the Agent narrative holds true, expectations for this round of infrastructure investment need to be lowered. ## Key Sources - [NVIDIA Inference Optimization Guide](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/mastering-llm-techniques-inference-optimization/), Prefill, Decode, KV Cache, and memory bandwidth - [AWS Trainium Official Documentation](https://aws.amazon.com/ai/machine-learning/trainium/), system design for chips, Neuron software stack, servers, networks, and cloud services - [Google Ironwood Official Introduction](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/infrastructure-and-cloud/google-cloud/ironwood-tpu-age-of-inference/), computing, memory, interconnection, and liquid cooling configurations for large-scale inference - [TSMC’s Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript](https://investor.tsmc.com/chinese/encrypt/files/encrypt_file/reports/2026-07/547d1696765e05ce3adb81c108ce1c8c1682b80c/TSMC+2Q26+Transcript.pdf), capital expenditure, expansion plans, and end-user deployment considerations - [SK hynix’s Q2 2026 Earnings Results](https://news.skhynix.com/en/q2-2026-business-results), HBM4 shipments, long-term agreements, and expansion plans

2b762667711fd0ca034712de5c5b0f9479590698.context: Agent 把任务完成变成新的成本单位
2b762667711fd0ca034712de5c5b0f9479590698.translation: I will use the following account to compare different reasoning systems.

48913fa57e29785130335b0623ccc7f285ea2f8c.source: 每百万有效 Token 成本 = 每小时完整系统成本 ÷ 每小时有效 Token 产出 × 1,000,000
48913fa57e29785130335b0623ccc7f285ea2f8c.context: Agent 把任务完成变成新的成本单位
48913fa57e29785130335b0623ccc7f285ea2f8c.translation: Cost per million valid tokens = Total system cost per hour ÷ Valid tokens generated per hour × 1,000,000

f3b80e235c00688a54d7f69818bfd23440303cf6.source: 完整系统成本包括加速器、HBM、服务器、网络、电力、液冷、软件、托管和折旧。
f3b80e235c00688a54d7f69818bfd23440303cf6.context: Agent 把任务完成变成新的成本单位
f3b80e235c00688a54d7f69818bfd23440303cf6.translation: The total system cost includes accelerators, HBM, servers, networking, power, liquid cooling, software, hosting, and depreciation.

589d26ff634f419941455d1a87495c53cb88daf4.source: 每小时有效 Token 产出需要放在固定模型、平均输入输出长度、并发数、延迟和质量要求下计算。排队超时、失败重试和未达到质量要求的结果不应计入产出，输入 Token、输出 Token 和缓存命中也要分开记录。
589d26ff634f419941455d1a87495c53cb88daf4.context: Agent 把任务完成变成新的成本单位
589d26ff634f419941455d1a87495c53cb88daf4.translation: The hourly effective Token output needs to be calculated under fixed models, average input and output lengths, concurrency levels, latency, and quality requirements. Results due to queue timeouts, failed retries, or those that do not meet quality standards should not be counted as output. Input Tokens, output Tokens, and cache hits also need to be recorded separately.

7158a9f54391886125d14e8a807656e835bbd536.source: 单位任务成本下降以后，更多的工作内容和能带来潜在收入的Idea才可能进入到不同的产品和流程。同时价格进一步下降，使用量也可能增加。这种增长有一个明确前提，任务完成率和结果价值必须同时达标。单纯生成更多 Token，只会增加设备使用量，不会自动形成健康的需求。
7158a9f54391886125d14e8a807656e835bbd536.context: Agent 把任务完成变成新的成本单位
7158a9f54391886125d14e8a807656e835bbd536.translation: Once the cost per unit of work decreases, more tasks and ideas that can generate potential revenue can be incorporated into various products and processes. As prices continue to fall, usage levels may also increase. This growth is contingent on two conditions: the task completion rate and the value of the results must both meet specified standards. Simply generating more tokens will only increase device usage without automatically creating healthy demand.

9e204fb591a358c29fe93b3ddb0c288d0c4d8c19.source: ## 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
9e204fb591a358c29fe93b3ddb0c288d0c4d8c19.translation: ## How an Agent task translates into infrastructure profits

73ff88cd49d9a5aeb8c9724cc4e7ac754cbfb59b.source: 一项可计费任务先产生模型调用和上下文处理需求，随后才形成对计算、内存、互联和机房的采购。下面这张图把需求传导、端侧第二曲线和金融风险压成三层。左到右看，越靠近用户的环节越容易掌握调度和计费入口，越靠近上游的环节越依赖产能、良率和认证形成议价权。
73ff88cd49d9a5aeb8c9724cc4e7ac754cbfb59b.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
73ff88cd49d9a5aeb8c9724cc4e7ac754cbfb59b.translation: A billable task first generates requirements for model invocation and context processing, before giving rise to purchases for computing power, memory, interconnects, and data centers. The diagram below presents these requirement flows, the on-device second curve, and financial risks as three layers. Moving from left to right, the stages closer to the user make it easier to control scheduling and billing, while those further upstream rely more on capacity, yield rates, and certifications to establish bargaining power.

91c18046730bfc7dde0ec64478e1a14488eb5935.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润

09509b2a0b26c1fbedb4369fe70c8fcd3b62e53d.source: GPU 的利润基础来自通用性、成熟的软件生态和快速适配新模型的能力。模型架构和请求形态仍在变化时，客户可以用同一套硬件和工具处理训练、开发和多类推理任务，迁移成本也相对可控。
09509b2a0b26c1fbedb4369fe70c8fcd3b62e53d.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
09509b2a0b26c1fbedb4369fe70c8fcd3b62e53d.translation: The profit foundation for GPUs lies in their versatility, mature software ecosystem, and ability to quickly adapt to new models. As model architectures and request formats continue to evolve, customers can use the same hardware and tools to handle training, development, and various inference tasks, with migration costs remaining relatively controllable.

d0dabd6689f54666e3d73c1cd6eea3d7f5a8319c.source: ASIC 可以围绕固定模型、固定精度和稳定请求形态优化成本与能效。它的经济性需要三个条件共同成立。工作负载达到足够规模，长期利用率能够覆盖芯片研发和部署投入，软件还要把客户原有的模型、算子和运维流程接进来。例如 AWS 把 Trainium 与 Neuron 软件栈、服务器、网络和云服务放在同一套产品里，Google 也用 TPU、互联和 Pathways 共同支撑大规模推理。这些说明，专用芯片的竞争单位已经扩展到整套系统。只比较单颗芯片的理论性能，很难判断它能否形成持续利润。
d0dabd6689f54666e3d73c1cd6eea3d7f5a8319c.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
d0dabd6689f54666e3d73c1cd6eea3d7f5a8319c.translation: ASICs can optimize costs and energy efficiency by leveraging fixed models, fixed precision, and consistent request patterns. Their economic viability depends on three conditions being met: the workload must be large enough so that long-term utilization can cover the costs associated with chip development and deployment; the software must be able to integrate the customer’s existing models, operators, and operational processes. For example, AWS combines the Trainium and Neuron software stacks with servers, networking, and cloud services in one unified product suite, while Google uses TPUs, interconnects, and Pathways to support large-scale inference. This shows that the competitive unit for specialized chips has expanded to include entire systems. It is difficult to determine whether a single chip can generate sustained profits by merely comparing its theoretical performance.

d2ec7c166276db6d8d87e6515ab165181916c124.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润

ab3855eb6ea02c33c4a965fbce4cf1540cf9eb60.source: 长上下文和并发请求会增加权重与 KV Cache 的内存占用，Decode 又需要持续搬运数据。HBM 的容量和带宽因此会影响加速器利用率。先进封装负责把计算芯片与多颗 HBM 组合起来，还要满足良率、功耗和客户认证要求。短期供给受限时，能稳定交付合格产品的供应商更容易获得溢价。
ab3855eb6ea02c33c4a965fbce4cf1540cf9eb60.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
ab3855eb6ea02c33c4a965fbce4cf1540cf9eb60.translation: Long contexts and concurrent requests increase the weight and memory usage of the KV Cache, while decoding requires continuous data transfer. As a result, the capacity and bandwidth of HBM affect the utilization rate of accelerators. Advanced packaging is responsible for combining computing chips with multiple HBM modules, while also meeting requirements regarding yield, power consumption, and customer certifications. When supply is limited in the short term, suppliers who can deliver qualified products consistently are more likely to receive premium prices.

ffe63eaef585b0f02ba306c2a920603f47671631.source: ==blue|这类溢价有清楚的回落条件。新产能投放、良率改善、替代方案通过认证，或者客户开始分散采购，供给紧张带来的议价权就会减弱==（例如出现很多长鑫之类的企业）。截至 2026 年 9 月，台积电已经把全年资本开支指引上调至 600 亿至 640 亿美元，并把客户推动扩产列为主要原因。SK hynix 披露 HBM4 已在 2026 年第二季度开始量产出货，下半年继续提升产量，同时已与约十家核心客户签订长期协议。这些公司披露说明需求和扩产正在同时发生，还不足以证明当前溢价能够长期维持。
ffe63eaef585b0f02ba306c2a920603f47671631.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
ffe63eaef585b0f02ba306c2a920603f47671631.translation: ==blue|Such premiums have clear conditions for declining. When new production capacity is added, yield improves, alternative solutions are approved, or customers start diversifying their suppliers, the bargaining power resulting from supply constraints weakens== (for example, with the emergence of many companies like CXMT). As of September 2026, TSMC has raised its full-year capital expenditure guidance to $60 billion to $64 billion, citing customer-driven capacity expansion as the main reason. SK hynix revealed that HBM4 production began in the second quarter of 2026, with output increasing further in the second half of the year, and it has already signed long-term agreements with around ten key customers. While these companies indicate that demand and capacity expansion are occurring simultaneously, this is not sufficient to prove that current premiums can be sustained in the long term.

b3fc04dfcebfc56ad590ca211ebc15af337f8722.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润

62139355d00e9f631285ee38a544b0ecc661a983.source: GPU 和 HBM 只有装进服务器、接入低延迟网络并获得稳定电力以后，才能形成可部署算力。Google 为 Ironwood 提供最多 9,216 颗芯片的液冷配置，整套系统功耗接近 10 MW。这个产品口径不能代表所有集群，却能说明采购边界已经延伸到芯片之外。
62139355d00e9f631285ee38a544b0ecc661a983.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
62139355d00e9f631285ee38a544b0ecc661a983.translation: Only when GPUs and HBM are installed in servers, connected to low-latency networks, and supplied with stable power can they form deployable computing power. Google provides Ironwood with a liquid-cooling setup featuring up to 9,216 chips, and the entire system consumes nearly 10 MW of power. While this product specification does not represent all clusters, it shows that the scope of procurement has expanded beyond just chips.

c6ac968485a786d102d05ba7d666b717d062d4a6.source: 这些环节的利润通常来自电力接入、交付速度、系统集成和可靠性。它们也承担==blue|**更长的建设周期与更重的资本投入**==。机房建成以后，折旧、维护和电力合同仍会继续发生。收入可以随着建设订单快速增长，资本回报则取决于设备是否按期上架、利用率能否达到假设，以及合同能否覆盖资产回收周期。
c6ac968485a786d102d05ba7d666b717d062d4a6.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
c6ac968485a786d102d05ba7d666b717d062d4a6.translation: The profits from these aspects typically come from power access, delivery speed, system integration, and reliability. They also entail ==blue|**longer construction periods and higher capital investment**==. Even after the data center is built, depreciation, maintenance, and power contracts continue to exist. Revenue can grow rapidly with new construction orders, while capital returns depend on whether the equipment is deployed on schedule, whether the utilization rate meets expectations, and whether the contracts cover the asset recovery period.

971348b86bb1dc134200ac5dd99aef57920c5aad.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润

16390184caeaf7c5363a3704fea0c3684bd56d86.source: 云厂商掌握客户入口、模型部署、任务路由和计费。调度软件可以提高批处理效率，复用缓存，减少空闲和失败重试，让同样的硬件完成更多任务。云平台还可以在 GPU 与自研 ASIC 之间分配工作负载，把硬件成本变化转成客户价格或平台毛利。
16390184caeaf7c5363a3704fea0c3684bd56d86.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
16390184caeaf7c5363a3704fea0c3684bd56d86.translation: Cloud providers control customer access points, model deployment, task routing, and billing. Scheduling software can improve batch processing efficiency, reuse caches, reduce idle time and failed retries, allowing the same hardware to handle more tasks. Cloud platforms can also distribute workloads between GPUs and custom ASICs, turning changes in hardware costs into customer prices or platform gross margins.

a0de5e575e78a73d446d0ba9663c26afcb62e30b.source: 这部分利润依赖客户使用规模、软件兼容性和迁移成本，也会受到价格竞争与资本开支的制约。云厂商购买了更多设备，只有在任务收入和现金流跟上以后，系统优势才会转成可持续回报。
a0de5e575e78a73d446d0ba9663c26afcb62e30b.context: 一项 Agent 任务怎样传导到基础设施利润
a0de5e575e78a73d446d0ba9663c26afcb62e30b.translation: This portion of the profit depends on the scale of customer usage, software compatibility, and migration costs; it is also influenced by price competition and capital expenditures. Only when task-related revenues and cash flows keep up can the advantages of such systems be transformed into sustainable returns, after cloud service providers have purchased more equipment.

ace5ce1f0d49adeb55399b0340de2ccdc72dd077.source: ## 融资让供给建设早于最终收入
ace5ce1f0d49adeb55399b0340de2ccdc72dd077.translation: ## Financing allows supply construction to precede final revenue

267f594c923f1cb583438b0de920071526fb314d.source: AI 基础设施具有很长的采购和建设周期。云厂商根据客户需求规划算力，GPU 云服务商根据合同建设机房，服务器、内存和封装厂商再根据订单扩产。每个环节看到的都是相对靠前的采购信号，最终用户是否会持续付费，往往要等设备上架以后才能验证。
267f594c923f1cb583438b0de920071526fb314d.context: 融资让供给建设早于最终收入
267f594c923f1cb583438b0de920071526fb314d.translation: AI infrastructure has a long procurement and construction cycle. Cloud providers plan computing power based on customer needs, GPU cloud service providers build data centers according to contracts, and server, memory, and packaging manufacturers expand production based on orders. At each stage, there are relatively early procurement signals, but it is often only after the equipment is available that it can be determined whether end-users will continue to pay for it.

615a813db16a6e3a493973d252767c3effbb3c9c.source: 台积电管理层在 2026 年第二季度业绩电话会上提到，客户各自给出的需求都可能是真实的，把所有需求相加以后仍然需要判断。公司还会检查数据中心的建设、地点和机架进度，避免芯片交付以后进入库存。这段表述说明，上游厂商已经意识到订单与最终部署之间存在距离。
615a813db16a6e3a493973d252767c3effbb3c9c.context: 融资让供给建设早于最终收入
615a813db16a6e3a493973d252767c3effbb3c9c.translation: TSMC’s management mentioned during the earnings call for the second quarter of 2026 that the demands submitted by each customer may be legitimate, but it is still necessary to make a judgment after adding up all those demands. The company will also monitor the progress of data center construction, location selection, and rack setup to prevent chips from ending up in inventory after delivery. This statement indicates that upstream manufacturers are already aware of the gap between orders and actual deployment.

2225eb53bfc2c3284a4fd62d4f0cee517a53ecde.source: 但同时，英伟达已经在和金融机构合作，通过包装芯片为一种金融资产去投资于小型初创企业，在自己扩大销量的同时，间接参与前沿科技投资，并建立深度绑定。这些初创公司根据协议以及需求，需要阶段性继续向英伟达购买芯片。又或者 Meta 成立空壳公司参与数据中心的建设，虽然账面上不影响母公司的业绩，但是这种金融包装行为随着后续的行业不稳定或其他层面的波动极有可能造成破坏性的影响。
2225eb53bfc2c3284a4fd62d4f0cee517a53ecde.context: 融资让供给建设早于最终收入
2225eb53bfc2c3284a4fd62d4f0cee517a53ecde.translation: At the same time, NVIDIA is already working with financial institutions to package its chips as financial assets in order to invest in small startups. By doing so, it can expand its sales while indirectly participating in investments in cutting-edge technologies and establishing strong ties with these companies. Under the terms of the agreements, these startups are required to continue purchasing chips from NVIDIA on a periodic basis. Alternatively, Meta sets up shell companies to undertake data center construction; although this does not affect the parent company’s financial results on paper, such financial engineering practices could have destructive consequences due to subsequent industry instability or other factors.

6268458e0bd595ba2371a6b3065dc61e3978f0a0.source: 这两件事指向同一个机制。融资把决策时点往前挪，也把风险挪到了决策者之外。云厂商和 GPU 云服务商买入设备时，资产和折旧记在自己表内，债务与租赁承诺却是刚性的。设备上架以后，无论上面有没有任务在跑，折旧、电力和利息都在发生；它们能提前锁定的只有合同和预付款，能往后拖的只有终端愿不愿意持续付费。
6268458e0bd595ba2371a6b3065dc61e3978f0a0.context: 融资让供给建设早于最终收入
6268458e0bd595ba2371a6b3065dc61e3978f0a0.translation: These two things point to the same mechanism. Financing shifts the decision-making point forward and also moves the risks away from the decision-makers. When cloud providers and GPU cloud service providers purchase equipment, the assets and depreciation are recorded in their own accounts, while the debts and leasing obligations remain fixed. Once the equipment is put into use, depreciation, electricity costs, and interest continue to accrue, regardless of whether there are tasks running on it; the only things they can lock in ahead of time are contracts and upfront payments, while the only thing that can be postponed is whether the end-users are willing to keep paying.

475c4fed38ec954e15c98e955155e95db6de38d0.source: 采购订单又沿着同一条链逐层下发。云厂商按合同规划算力，GPU 云服务商按同一批合同建设机房，服务器、内存和封装厂商再根据这些订单扩产。每一层看到的都是上一层给出的确定信号，没有任何一层能看到所有层加总之后的真实使用量。合同把未来几年的调用预期提前折成今天的订单，这些订单叠加起来的总供给就可能超过当下的付费需求。每一层的判断单独看都成立，加总之后却可能超出真实使用量。
475c4fed38ec954e15c98e955155e95db6de38d0.context: 融资让供给建设早于最终收入
475c4fed38ec954e15c98e955155e95db6de38d0.translation: Purchase orders are then issued layer by layer along the same chain. Cloud service providers allocate computing power according to the contracts, while GPU cloud service providers build data centers based on those same contracts; server, memory, and packaging manufacturers then expand their production in response to these orders. Each level relies on the confirmed signals from the level above, with no single level able to see the total actual usage across all levels. Contracts convert expected usage over the next few years into orders today, and the combined supply resulting from these orders may exceed current payment demands. While each individual decision at a particular level is reasonable, the sum of these decisions can still exceed the actual usage level.

5005656d1a1c3055202cc83a2146e24cd7fbbd94.source: 种种现象都没有证明泡沫已经发生，但是又无时无刻不揭示着目前的杠杆越加越大。它们说明长期合同和融资可以把未来收入提前转换成今天的服务器、GPU 和机房。只要有效任务持续增长，提前建设可以缩短交付时间，也能提高资产利用率。需求增速、续约率或利用率低于采购假设以后，租赁、折旧、电力和利息仍会继续发生。
5005656d1a1c3055202cc83a2146e24cd7fbbd94.context: 融资让供给建设早于最终收入
5005656d1a1c3055202cc83a2146e24cd7fbbd94.translation: None of these phenomena prove that a bubble has formed, but they constantly indicate that the level of leverage is increasing. They show that long-term contracts and financing can convert future revenues into servers, GPUs, and data centers today. As valid workloads continue to grow, building in advance can shorten delivery times and improve asset utilization. Even if demand growth, renewal rates, or utilization fall short of the assumptions made during procurement, costs such as leasing, depreciation, electricity, and interest will still continue to arise.

0878cba261ba46b8cdb01eb3ef953827e71b5d7d.source: ==blue|压力不会同时出现在所有指标上，也不会平均分布。即使模型调用总量仍在增长，只要供给增长得更快，最先承压的是价格类信号，包括 GPU 租赁价格、二手设备残值、服务器库存和部分内存价格。利用率和续约率属于经营结果，滞后一步；资产回报要等折旧和利息走完一个周期才显现。上游还可能在终端需求放缓以前继续收到订单，直到某个环节发现新增收入不足以覆盖资本成本，金融放大过程才会反向传导，造成牛鞭效应。==
0878cba261ba46b8cdb01eb3ef953827e71b5d7d.context: 融资让供给建设早于最终收入
0878cba261ba46b8cdb01eb3ef953827e71b5d7d.translation: ==blue|Pressure does not appear across all indicators at the same time, nor is it distributed evenly. Even as the total number of model invocations continues to rise, if supply grows faster, price-related signals are the first to be affected, including GPU rental prices, residual values of used devices, server inventory, and certain memory prices. Utilization rates and renewal rates are outcomes of operational performance and lag behind; asset returns become apparent only after a full cycle of depreciation and interest has passed. Suppliers may continue to receive orders before demand at the end of the chain slows down, until a certain point where it becomes clear that the additional revenue is not sufficient to cover capital costs. Only then does the financial amplification effect work in reverse, resulting in a bullwhip effect.==

c5f0b3dfbafbac2bbf700abe30728e89d2d4ae0d.source: ## 端侧是等待使用行为验证的第二条曲线
c5f0b3dfbafbac2bbf700abe30728e89d2d4ae0d.translation: ## On-device is the second curve that awaits verification through usage behavior.

394117dcee9484c9fee46172627de66a49b9599f.source: 汽车助手和家庭控制中枢需要快速响应，弱网时也要完成一部分操作。车内状态、家庭传感器和个人习惯还涉及隐私，本地处理可以减少部分数据上传。端侧适合承担唤醒、感知、简单决策和高频控制，复杂推理与长上下文仍可以交给云端。
394117dcee9484c9fee46172627de66a49b9599f.context: 端侧是等待使用行为验证的第二条曲线
394117dcee9484c9fee46172627de66a49b9599f.translation: Car assistants and home control hubs need to respond quickly, even in poor network conditions, and must still complete certain tasks. Since vehicle status, home sensors, and personal habits involve privacy issues, local processing can reduce the amount of data that needs to be uploaded. On-device processing is well-suited for tasks such as wake-up, sensing, simple decision-making, and frequent control, while complex reasoning and long-context handling can still be handled by the cloud.

96faf82ad0eac075a242d6b67a84a2792bc1b7d6.source: ^[同时也更加适合未来的端侧智能助手的记忆、持续学习等功能]
96faf82ad0eac075a242d6b67a84a2792bc1b7d6.context: 端侧是等待使用行为验证的第二条曲线
96faf82ad0eac075a242d6b67a84a2792bc1b7d6.translation: ^[It is also more suitable for future functions such as memory and continuous learning in on-device intelligent assistants.]

179ec3458d94ac6241e69dd2d13e57f8a029bda6.source: 本地运行消耗的是用户设备的电力，设备厂商仍要承担前置投入。更高规格的 SoC、内存和存储会增加 BOM，散热、模型适配、安全、OTA 更新和多年售后也需要工程资源。厂商只有在本地推理能够支持更高售价、减少云端调用支出、改善体验，或者满足隐私与离线要求时，才有理由长期承担这些成本。
179ec3458d94ac6241e69dd2d13e57f8a029bda6.context: 端侧是等待使用行为验证的第二条曲线
179ec3458d94ac6241e69dd2d13e57f8a029bda6.translation: Local execution consumes power from the user’s device, and device manufacturers still have to bear the initial investment costs. Higher-specification SoCs, memory, and storage increase the Bill of Materials cost, while cooling, model adaptation, security, OTA updates, and long-term after-sales support also require engineering resources. Manufacturers will only have reason to bear these costs in the long term if local inference enables higher pricing, reduces cloud-based processing expenses, improves the user experience, or meets privacy and offline requirements.

9a49d8eec0434ae9b2bc1b6fdbe13719b53dad01.source: 端侧芯片还要在有限功耗下处理模型更新。低比特计算、更高效的内存架构和端云调度可以缓解限制，能够部署不等于形成稳定需求。汽车和家庭设备的真实使用频率、本地运行占比、硬件增量成本和产品毛利，仍然是这条曲线最重要的验证指标。
9a49d8eec0434ae9b2bc1b6fdbe13719b53dad01.context: 端侧是等待使用行为验证的第二条曲线
9a49d8eec0434ae9b2bc1b6fdbe13719b53dad01.translation: On-device chips also need to process model updates while operating with limited power consumption. Low-bit computing, more efficient memory architectures, and on-cloud scheduling can help alleviate these constraints, but just being able to deploy something does not necessarily mean there is a stable demand for it. The actual usage frequency of cars and home devices, the proportion of operations performed locally, the incremental hardware costs, and the gross profit of products remain the most important metrics for validating this curve.

ba493ccdaa07af658da888ad0785d092b212cc60.source: 端侧一旦进入高频设备，需求会更分散，也更接近用户每天的真实行为。当前公开材料仍不足以证明这一阶段已经到来，所以我会把它保留为第二条曲线，不把产品演示提前写成大规模芯片订单。
ba493ccdaa07af658da888ad0785d092b212cc60.context: 端侧是等待使用行为验证的第二条曲线
ba493ccdaa07af658da888ad0785d092b212cc60.translation: Once on-device applications become part of high-frequency devices, the requirements will be more diverse and closer to users' actual daily behaviors. The available materials so far are not sufficient to prove that this stage has arrived, so I will keep it as the second curve, without assuming large-scale chip orders in the product demonstrations yet.

a4231a841fff502ca757bc29cdfdce71e26c81a8.translation: ## Signals for Ongoing Monitoring in the Future

7db3c7d74e4b06cc95263b9ff7e7b390cd0c8b57.source: 云端需求要看付费任务量、任务完成率和单位任务收入。有效 Token 可以帮助比较推理系统，但它要和延迟、质量、失败率一起看。云厂商的资本开支还要转化为 AI 云服务收入、现金流和更高的每兆瓦产出。
7db3c7d74e4b06cc95263b9ff7e7b390cd0c8b57.translation: For cloud services, the demand is determined by the volume of paid tasks, task completion rates, and revenue per task. Valid tokens can assist in comparing reasoning systems, but they need to be considered alongside latency, quality, and failure rates. Cloud service providers’ capital expenditures should translate into revenue from AI cloud services, improved cash flow, and higher output per megawatt.

3d8143c7607396f755ea33578860e2da997dde3f.source: 供应链要看 HBM 与标准 DRAM 的价格和库存是否分化，先进封装的交付周期是否缩短，GPU 租赁价格和二手残值是否开始下降。供给紧张带来的利润，只有在扩产以后仍能保持良率、认证优势和客户黏性，才更接近耐久优势。
3d8143c7607396f755ea33578860e2da997dde3f.translation: In terms of the supply chain, it is necessary to observe whether there is a divergence in prices and inventory levels between HBM and standard DRAM, whether the delivery times for advanced packaging are shortening, and whether GPU rental prices and second-hand residual values are starting to decline. The profits resulting from supply constraints can only be transformed into sustainable advantages if good yield rates, certification advantages, and customer loyalty can be maintained even after capacity expansion.

f8a111cb091b694a8114fe097048abb2b65407d6.source: 金融结构要看合同期限、债务期限和 GPU 经济寿命能否匹配。客户续约、机房上架进度和利用率，能够判断长期合同是在锁定真实需求，还是把未来需求提前计入了今天的投资。
f8a111cb091b694a8114fe097048abb2b65407d6.translation: In terms of the financial structure, it is necessary to consider whether the contract duration, debt maturity period, and the economic lifespan of GPUs are compatible with each other. Customer renewals, the progress of deploying servers in data centers, and their utilization rates can help determine whether long-term contracts reflect actual demand or represent the anticipation of future demand being accounted for in today’s investments.

93d40f16645062cb5e76f5ac4ffb6d568334ce67.source: 端侧要看助手的日均使用次数、本地完成比例和设备毛利。汽车与家庭设备开始承担高频任务以后，端侧芯片需求才会从配置竞争转成用户愿意持续使用的产品能力。
93d40f16645062cb5e76f5ac4ffb6d568334ce67.translation: On-device metrics to watch include the average daily usage frequency of the assistant, the proportion of tasks completed locally, and the gross profit per device. Only when cars and home devices start handling frequent tasks will the demand for on-device chips shift from a competition over specifications to product capabilities that users are willing to use consistently.

62691149d0e48db9ab8e2ab5d220efcf6023725a.source: 如果有效任务和收入能够跟上算力供给，GPU、ASIC、HBM、封装和数据中心仍有扩张空间。利润会更多留在能降低单位任务成本、掌握受限供给或控制客户与调度入口的环节。当租赁价格和残值这类领先信号持续走弱，利用率、续约和资产回报又持续低于采购假设时，即使 Agent 叙事仍然成立，这一轮基础设施投资也需要下调预期。
62691149d0e48db9ab8e2ab5d220efcf6023725a.translation: If effective tasks and revenue can keep up with the supply of computing power, there is still room for growth in GPUs, ASICs, HBM, packaging, and data centers. Profits will remain concentrated in those areas that can reduce the cost per task, gain control over limited supplies, or manage customers and scheduling processes. When leading indicators such as rental prices and residual values continue to decline, and utilization rates, renewal rates, and asset returns remain below the assumptions made at the time of acquisition, even if the Agent narrative holds true, expectations for this round of infrastructure investment need to be lowered.
